fingerprint_spec.metric: Tanimoto coefficient T(A,B) = |A cap B| / |A cup B|

standardization_spec.rationale: Validates valence, strips counterions if present, and canonicalizes aromaticity while preserving curated keto/enol states and stereocenters (R/S, E/Z).

peptide_pka_spec.model: Henderson-Hasselbalch Monoprotic Additive Model at pH 7.4
peptide_pka_spec.note: Computes both side-chain formal charge sum and full Henderson-Hasselbalch net charge (including free N-terminal alpha-ammonium and C-terminal alpha-carboxylate groups).

chemle.name: 1-Hydroxyphenazine
chemle.review_notes: Verified Learn pilot compound matching PubChem CID 135412648 and ChEBI CHEBI:62216.
chemle.CNS_MPO_Method: 4-parameter RDKit CNS desirability (cLogP, MW, TPSA, HBD; max 4.0) + 6-term heuristic proxy (max 6.0)

chemle.hint_origin: Formed via oxidative decarboxylation of phenazine-1-carboxylate by PhzS monooxygenase.
chemle.structural_note: Planar tricyclic phenazine bearing a single peri C1 hydroxyl phenol group.

learn.text: Broad Super-Class: Microbial & Aromatic Catabolite

learn.text: Broad-spectrum polyketide antifungal mediating take-all disease suppression in wheat rhizosphere pseudomonads.

chemle.name: 4-Hydroxybenzoic acid
chemle.review_notes: Verified Learn pilot compound matching PubChem CID 135 and ChEBI CHEBI:30763.
chemle.CNS_MPO_Method: 4-parameter RDKit CNS desirability (cLogP, MW, TPSA, HBD; max 4.0) + 6-term heuristic proxy (max 6.0)
chemle.hint_role: Para-substituted phenolic carboxylate feeding bacterial protocatechuate conversion and eukaryotic ubiquinone synthesis.
chemle.hint_origin: Derived from chorismate via UbiC lyase in prokaryotes or tyrosine ammonia-lyase beta-oxidation in eukaryotes.
chemle.structural_note: Benzene ring carrying both a carboxylate and a para-positioned hydroxyl group (1,4-disubstituted).

chemle.name: Fluoxetine
chemle.review_notes: Clinically marketed and biologically dosed as the racemic (R,S)-fluoxetine mixture (PubChem CID 3386).
chemle.CNS_MPO_Method: 4-parameter RDKit CNS desirability (cLogP, MW, TPSA, HBD; max 4.0) + 6-term heuristic proxy (max 6.0)
chemle.hint_role: Selective monoamine reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) blocking the presynaptic SERT transporter.
chemle.hint_origin: Developed as diphenhydramine analogue LY110140 with high selectivity for 5-HT over norepinephrine.
chemle.structural_note: Contains two benzene rings, a secondary methylamine, an aryl ether, and a para-trifluoromethyl (-CF3) group.

chemle.review_notes: Verified Learn pilot compound matching PubChem CID 4539 and ChEBI CHEBI:100246.
chemle.CNS_MPO_Method: 4-parameter RDKit CNS desirability (cLogP, MW, TPSA, HBD; max 4.0) + 6-term heuristic proxy (max 6.0)

chemle.structural_note: 2-Hydroxybenzoic acid: forms an intramolecular six-membered H-bond between its ortho-phenol and carboxyl group.

seqle.title: Orphanin FQ / Nociceptin Receptor Agonist
seqle.hint_role: Extreme N-terminal 'message' pentapeptide activating the NOP opioid-related GPCR while excluding classical mu/delta subtypes.
seqle.hint_detail: Replaces the N-terminal phenolic Tyr1 of enkephalins with an unhydroxylated Phe1, a flexible achiral dipeptide spacer, Phe4, and Thr5.
seqle.context_requirement: Requires a free N-terminal alpha-amino group on Phe1 to form a salt bridge with Asp130 in the NOP receptor pocket.

reference_provenance.notes: Human Prepronociceptin cleaved mature Nociceptin (130-146); N-terminus generated by dibasic KR cleavage.

seqle.title: Zincin Metalloprotease Catalytic Helix
seqle.hint_role: Two imidazole side chains coordinate the active-site Zn2+ ion while glutamate polarizes the attacking water.
seqle.hint_detail: Conserved active-site signature across matrixins (MMPs), thermolysin, and neurotoxins.
seqle.context_requirement: Must fold as an active-site alpha-helix so i and i+4 His imidazole rings project onto the same face toward Zn2+.

reference_provenance.notes: Human MMP3 Stromelysin-1 Zn-binding helix.

seqle.title: Tyrosine Kinase Catalytic Loop Base
seqle.hint_role: Central aspartate acts as general proton acceptor for the substrate hydroxyl group during gamma-phosphoryl transfer.
seqle.hint_detail: Cationic arginine neutralizes the phosphorylated regulatory loop to align the active site.
seqle.context_requirement: Located in the C-lobe catalytic loop between beta-6 and beta-7 strands directly facing the ATP gamma-phosphate.

reference_provenance.notes: Human KIT catalytic loop.

seqle.title: KRAS4B C-Terminal CAAX Prenylation Tail
seqle.hint_role: Farnesyltransferase attaches a C15 isoprenoid lipid to the fourth-from-last thiol before tripeptide proteolysis.
seqle.hint_detail: Preceded by a polybasic lysine track; final methionine residue directs high-affinity farnesylation.
seqle.context_requirement: Strictly requires extreme C-terminal positioning; -VIM is cleaved by Rce1 and alpha-carboxyl-methylated by ICMT.

reference_provenance.notes: Human KRAS Isoform 2B polybasic C-terminal CaaX farnesylation box; RCSB SIFTS maps 1D8D entity 3 to base P01116.

seqle.hint_role: Cytosolic extreme C-terminal retrieval signal on ER-resident membrane proteins recognized by alpha/beta'-COP WD40 propellers.
seqle.hint_detail: Alternating cationic primary amines at positions -5 and -3 from the C-terminus pair with an acidic side chain, polar hydroxyl, and terminal carboxylate.
seqle.context_requirement: Canonical extreme C-terminal K-X-K-X-X retrieval signal (lysines at positions -5 and -3; co-crystallized AKEKSD peptide in PDB:4J77 entity 1).

reference_provenance.notes: Human OST48/DDOST extreme C-terminal -KxKxx COPI retrieval signal (452-456); PDB:4J77 entity 1 is co-crystallized Wbp1 C-terminal peptide AKEKSD.

seqle.hint_role: Recruits the Anaphase-Promoting Complex coactivator to ubiquitinate cell-cycle kinases during late mitosis and G1.

seqle.hint_role: Simplified 5-residue teaching representation of a CRM1-binding nuclear translocation signal (Learn mode only).

seqle.title: ER Luminal N-Linked Glycosylation Sequon
seqle.hint_role: Oligosaccharyltransferase transfers a 14-sugar Glc3Man9GlcNAc2 precursor onto the primary carboxamide nitrogen.
seqle.hint_detail: Requires Asn at position 1, any residue except Pro at position 2, and Thr or Ser at position 3 (synthetic G-Y padding completes the 5-mer).
seqle.context_requirement: Synthetic N-[^P]-[ST] eukaryotic acceptor sequon example (no universal Tyr5 requirement; PDB:3WAK is apo archaeal AglB UniProt:O29867).
seqle.exemplar_source: ELM:MOD_N-GLC_1; PDB:3WAK (motif-family context only: apo Archaeoglobus fulgidus AglB UniProt:O29867)

citations.notes: PDB:3WAK is apo Archaeoglobus fulgidus AglB oligosaccharyltransferase (no bound acceptor peptide; UniProt O29867 lacks NLTGY).

seqle.title: Integrin Beta-3 Talin-Binding Cytoplasmic Turn
seqle.hint_role: Binds the F3 FERM domain of cytoskeletal adaptors to switch adhesion receptors from bent-inactive to extended-active states.
seqle.hint_detail: Carboxamide-proline-leucine-phenol beta-turn capped by a basic primary-amine side chain in membrane-proximal receptor tails.
seqle.context_requirement: Located in the membrane-proximal cytoplasmic tail of Integrin Beta-3; Tyr phosphorylation switches binding to Dok1.

seqle.hint_role: Complete native delta- and mu-receptor agonist pentapeptide cleaved from proenkephalin-A.
seqle.hint_detail: N-terminal Tyr1 phenol and free alpha-amine mimic the tyramine pharmacophore of morphine; ends with methionine.
seqle.context_requirement: Functions as an intact free pentapeptide neurotransmitter released by prohormone convertases.

reference_provenance.notes: Human Proenkephalin-A cleaved mature Met-enkephalin pentapeptide (100-104).

seqle.title: Clathrin AP-2 Mu2 Tyrosine Sorting Signal
seqle.hint_role: Binds the medium subunit of heterotetrameric vesicle adaptor complexes for rapid endocytosis from the plasma membrane.
seqle.hint_detail: Requires an unphosphorylated N-terminal phenolic residue and a bulky hydrophobic side chain three positions downstream.
seqle.context_requirement: Must be in an extended conformation within a cytosolic receptor tail; Tyr phosphorylation blocks AP-2 binding.
seqle.exemplar_source: UniProt:P19814 (Rat TGN38 Cytoplasmic Tail 350-354); PDB:1BXX; ELM:TRG_ENDOCYTIC_1

reference_provenance.notes: Rat TGN38 tyrosine-based AP2 internalization motif; PDB:1BXX entity 2 is synthetic DYQRLN peptide.
